profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: I'm a student, helper, and geek. I'm always trying to learn new things and push myself past my current abilities. Because the more tools in my belt, the more able I am to help out where needed. This may come from my determination to find an answer if I'm unable to answer a question myself. This usually makes me the volunteer for projects. Lastly I'm kind of a geek, and I'm part of multiple organized groups. This helps me adapt to most environment that I'm placed in. It also helps me learn about community-building and networking.

projects.title: Connect Four
projects.description: I successfully created a Connect Four game using vanilla JavaScript as a side project. Although it's rudimentary, I'm planning to enhance it with better animation in the future.

projects.title: Pong
projects.description: I am proud of my first successful attempt at creating a real game with Phaser.js, a powerful JavaScript library. By choosing a classic game like Pong, I improved my skills and learned more about the library. Although the project is complete, I am continuously working on ways to improve it and make it even better.
